name: Kim Fuchs
description: Kim graduated from Carson-Newman University and holds a Master’s degree in Curriculum and Instruction from Lincoln Memorial University. She brings more than 35 years of experience serving children and families through both education and ministry.

name: Taylore Sanzo
description: Taylore graduated from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville with a degree in Finance and Accounting and has been homeschooling her family for the past three years. She brings a heart for organization and service to her role and is passionate about partnering with families to create a Christ-centered learning community.
